bloc.Obligation : Haut risque (Annexe III poi: Obligation: High risk (Annex III, point #(b)). Technical documentation, mandatory human oversight, informing employees. Compatibility with GDPR Art. # to be checked.
Obligation: High risk (Annex III, point #(b-c)). Technical documentation, right to an explanation of the decision, human oversight. GDPR Art. # if the decision is automated.

Obligation: High risk (Annex III, point #). Informing the data subjects is mandatory. Human oversight of admission or assessment decisions.
bloc.Obligation : Haut risque (Art. #§# + Ann: Obligation: High risk (Art. #(#) + Annex III). FRIA mandatory for public bodies (Art. #). Technical documentation and human oversight required.
bloc.Obligation : Haut risque systématique (A: Obligation: Systematically high risk (Annex III, point #). Remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces: prohibited save for the exceptions in Art. #(#). Emotion recognition in the workplace: prohibited (Art. #(#)(f)).
bloc.Obligation : Information claire que l'ut: Obligation: Clear information that the user is interacting with an AI (Art. #(#)). Applicable from # August #.
bloc.Obligation : Informer les utilisateurs q: Obligation: Inform users that the content is personalised by AI (Art. #(#)). Manipulation exploiting psychological vulnerabilities: prohibited, Art. #(#)(a). Social scoring systems: prohibited, Art. #(#)(c).
bloc.Obligation : Marquage machine-readable d: Obligation: Machine-readable marking of generated content (Art. #(#)). Deepfakes and texts of public interest: mandatory disclosure (Art. #(#)). Digital Omnibus deadline: # December #.
bloc.Obligation : Modification substantielle: Obligation: Substantial modification → provider obligations (Art. #). Transparency under Art. # if there is interaction with people.
bloc.Obligation : Pas d'obligation directe AI: Obligation: No direct AI Act obligation, but a knock-on risk of non-compliance (unmarked content, undocumented bias).
bloc.Obligation : Si décisionnel sur des pers: Obligation: If it takes decisions about people: potentially high risk. Otherwise, good practice under ISO/IEC #.
bloc.Obligation : Si l'infrastructure est cri: Obligation: If the infrastructure is critical (water, energy, finance, digital): high risk (Annex III, point #). Otherwise: limited risk, but NIS # applies in parallel.
bloc.Obligation : Si la traduction produit du: Obligation: If the translation produces published content: marking under Art. #(#). If the model is GPAI: check that the provider complies with Art. # (documentation, acceptable use policy).
bloc.Obligation : Vérifier auprès de l'éditeu: Obligation: Check the risk level with the vendor. If there is interaction with people: Art. #(#) applicable from # August #.
bloc.Obligation : Vérifier documentation du f: Obligation: Check the provider’s documentation (Art. # if GPAI). If there is interaction with people: Art. # is your responsibility.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Ajouter une clause contractu: 💡 Tip: Add a standard contractual clause requiring the disclosure of any use of AI in deliverables.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Attention aux traductions da: 💡 Tip: Beware of translations in regulated contexts (medical, legal, financial) — an AI translation error can create liability without the service provider being covered.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Clarifier en interne qui por: 💡 Tip: Clarify internally who bears the “provider” responsibility — often overlooked because it is perceived as a technical use.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Conserver les CGU et garanti: 💡 Tip: Keep the API provider’s terms of use and warranties — useful in the event of a substantial modification (Art. #).
bloc.💡 Conseil : Distinguer la personnalisati: 💡 Tip: Distinguish legitimate personalisation (Art. # → transparency) from manipulative practices (Art. # → prohibition). The line can be thin depending on the techniques used.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Distinguer les usages intern: 💡 Tip: Distinguish internal uses from published content — only the latter triggers the disclosure obligation.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Documenter quelles données s: 💡 Tip: Document which data is accessible — a poorly partitioned RAG agent can expose sensitive data.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Informer explicitement les s: 💡 Tip: Inform employees explicitly before any deployment — the combined AI Act + GDPR + employment law regime makes this case particularly exposed to legal challenges.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Interroger les achats et l'I: 💡 Tip: Ask procurement and IT about the AI options already switched on in SaaS contracts.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Le médecin reste responsable: 💡 Tip: The physician remains responsible for the final decision — AI cannot replace clinical judgement. Document the chain of responsibility explicitly.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Les établissements d'enseign: 💡 Tip: Educational institutions are often unaware of their status as high-risk deployers when they use third-party assessment or guidance tools.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Prioriser dans le Registre —: 💡 Tip: Prioritise in the register — high risk of employment tribunal litigation.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Vérifier en premier si l'usa: 💡 Tip: First check whether the intended use falls under the prohibited practices of Art. # — before even talking about high-risk compliance.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Vérifier la compatibilité RG: 💡 Tip: Check compatibility with GDPR Art. # (right not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing) — this case combines two regulatory regimes.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Vérifier que la mention appa: 💡 Tip: Check that the notice appears from the very first message, not only in the legal notices.
bloc.💡 Conseil : Vérifier si votre organisati: 💡 Tip: Check whether your organisation is an operator of essential importance (OIE) or of importance (OII) within the meaning of NIS # — the combined AI Act + NIS # regime is particularly demanding.
bloc.📅 Échéance du # août # — Art. # pleineme: 📅 Deadline of # August # — Art. # fully applicable: explicit information in the event of interaction with an AI, marking of synthetic content, disclosure of deepfakes.
